symptoms.title: Early specks and streaks
symptoms.description: Tiny pale-yellow or reddish-brown specks usually begin on the underside of a leaf and lengthen into streaks parallel to the leaf veins.

symptoms.title: Darkening lesions
symptoms.description: The streaks enlarge and darken from brown to nearly black, becoming narrow oval or elongated spots.

symptoms.title: Gray centers and yellow halos
symptoms.description: Older lesions may develop dry light-gray centers, dark borders, and bright yellow halos.

symptoms.title: Coalescing and leaf death
symptoms.description: Numerous lesions can merge into large dead areas, reducing green leaf area and causing premature drying.

treatment.title: Confirm the diagnosis
treatment.description: Black Sigatoka can resemble other leaf spots. Ask a local crop or plant-health specialist to confirm severe or spreading cases.

treatment.title: Prune infected tissue carefully
treatment.description: Remove heavily spotted leaf portions or leaves to lower spores, but retain enough healthy leaf area for plant growth.

treatment.title: Use integrated management
treatment.description: Improve drainage, spacing, nutrition, and sanitation. Use a fungicide only when locally registered and recommended, and follow its label and resistance-management guidance.

prevention.title: Inspect new leaves regularly
prevention.description: Check both leaf surfaces for early specks and vein-parallel streaks so infected tissue can be managed before lesions merge.

prevention.title: Improve airflow and drainage
prevention.description: Use suitable plant spacing, control excess suckers, and prevent waterlogging to reduce humid conditions around leaves.

prevention.title: Use clean planting material
prevention.description: Plant healthy material from a reliable source and avoid carrying infected leaves or debris into clean areas.

prevention.title: Maintain balanced plant care
prevention.description: Provide suitable water and nutrition, and remove highly infected leaf tissue as part of a regular field sanitation program.
